{
  "answer_text": "Because Production, Staging, Local, and Custom are distinct API Base URLs (different hosts), an MCP client must treat a base-URL change as switching to a separate environment — stop relying on cached discovery results or session state from the previous URL and start a fresh session and discovery against the new host so request IDs and message ordering aren’t mixed between environments.",
  "source_quote": "API Base URL

Production (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io)


Staging (staging.registry.modelcontextprotocol.io)


Local (localhost:8080)


Custom"
}
